We're hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer (Uber Tech Lead) for Identity & Access Management within Platform and own the technical strategy that unifies human, AI agent, service, and workload identity into one coherent platform. IAM is a distributed problem across 700+ internal systems that no central team can implement alone, so this platform must make access consistent, visible, provable, and efficient across every identity type. You'll set architecture across multiple pods, drive adoption with hundreds of engineering teams, and act as one of the most senior technical voices for identity and access management at Coinbase.

What you'll do:

• Own the multi-year technical strategy for IAM end to end, including the architecture that unifies workforce, AI agent, and service/workload identity under a common model with shared primitives for authentication, authorization, provisioning, and governance.

• Drive architecture decisions across multiple pods and teams you don't manage - establishing the standards, review bars, and integration contracts the rest of engineering builds against.

• Build the adoption strategy for 700+ systems, including sequencing, migration paths, and build-vs-buy decisions that determine what we own versus integrate.

• Partner with Security, Compliance, IT, Infrastructure, and product engineering leadership to translate audit and regulatory requirements (UAR, SOX, SOC 2) into automated controls and self-generating evidence.

• Lead the data model and tooling that answer "who has access to what, and why" across a heterogeneous estate, reducing standing privilege while making the secure path the fast path.

• Grow the technical bench by mentoring staff and senior engineers and raising the org's depth in identity as a domain.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 12+ years of software engineering experience, including a track record as the most senior technical leader on a platform spanning multiple teams with multi-year architecture driven to adoption across dozens of consuming teams.

• Deep IAM expertise across more than one domain (workforce identity, authorization, access lifecycle, or non-human identity) with substantive experience in service or workload identity - service-to-service auth, workload identity federation, or machine credential management at scale.

• Production Go experience and distributed systems design on AWS, with fluency in identity protocols and standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and workload identity patterns).

• Proven influence without authority at senior levels - you've changed the technical direction of teams and orgs outside your own and secured leadership alignment on ambiguous, org-wide access-risk problems.

• Ability to translate audit and regulatory requirements into automated technical controls, with clear written and verbal communication that frames complex identity problems for executive audiences.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 
 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Build operating rhythms, reviews, and forums that keep the Pro org aligned and focused on priorities.

 - Lead and deliver cross-functional projects that don’t fit neatly into a single team but are critical to Pro’s success.

 - Support leadership in decision-making by framing issues, tracking KPIs, and surfacing gaps or risks early.

 - Maintain systems for reporting, business reviews, roadmap coordination, and cross-team initiatives.

 - Partner with leadership to scope and stand up new initiatives in Spot, Margin, Derivatives, or Infrastructure — from early concept through initial execution.

 - Contribute to high-impact materials (exec updates, all-hands, strategic memos) that provide clarity and visibility.

 - Act as the first line of intake for inbound requests, triage them effectively, and ensure accountability for follow-through.

 - Identify bottlenecks in how we operate and propose improvements that help the team scale more efficiently.

 - Use business intelligence and data to support PMs and leadership across Pro, cutting through competing priorities and surface the best opportunities.

 - Partner with Compliance and Legal teams to find ways to improve product experience.

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5–7 years in BizOps, Product Ops, Strategy, Consulting, or similar high-leverage roles with measurable impact.

 - Strong project management skills — you can bring structure to ambiguity and drive initiatives from 0 → 1.

 - Comfortable with data: you can interpret dashboards, KPIs, and financial/operational metrics to drive insight.

 - Excellent communicator who can adapt across audiences — from execs to cross-functional ICs.

 - Highly organized, detail-driven, and biased toward follow-through and execution.

 - Self-starter who doesn’t wait for instructions — you create the roadmap when one doesn’t exist.

 - Experience collaborating across product, engineering, compliance, legal, finance, and marketing.

 - Belief in Kraken’s mission to accelerate financial freedom and inclusion through crypto.

ML Ops Engineer
London

We’re hiring an ML Ops Engineer to build and operate the platform capabilities that take machine-learning models from experimentation into reliable production services.

You’ll own the automation, deployment, observability and operational controls around the ML lifecycle, working closely with research engineers, software engineers, platform teams and product teams.

This is not a research role. It is a hands-on engineering role focused on making ML systems reproducible, scalable, secure and dependable, from model packaging and release through to serving, monitoring, retraining and incident response.

What you’ll work on
ML lifecycle and platform engineering
• Build repeatable workflows for model training, validation, promotion, deployment and retraining.
• Productionise models through packaging, versioning, model registry integration, deployment automation and safe rollback.
• Design CI/CD pipelines for ML systems, including automated testing, validation, release controls and environment promotion.
• Manage experiment tracking, model metadata and reproducibility across research and production.
• Build reusable tooling and platform capabilities that support multiple models and engineering teams.
Model serving and observability
• Deploy and operate batch and online inference services in containerised cloud environments.
• Define and meet availability, latency, throughput and recovery objectives for ML services.
• Monitor service health, infrastructure, data-quality signals, data drift, prediction drift and model performance decay.
• Establish dashboards, alerting and operational runbooks so failures are detected and resolved quickly.
• Support automated or controlled retraining, model promotion, rollback and model retirement.
• Debug production issues across model, application, infrastructure and critical data-dependency layers.
Reliability, security and engineering quality
• Improve system robustness, scalability and cost efficiency through automation, observability and infrastructure as code.
• Write production-grade Python for long-running services, deployment tooling and ML workflows.
• Establish testing, validation, release and incident-management practices for ML systems.
• Collaborate with platform, security and data engineering teams on reliable model inputs, access controls, secrets, resilience and compliance.
• Make explicit trade-offs between research flexibility, delivery speed, operational risk and production stability.
Additional responsibilities
• Maintain personal/professional development to meet the changing demands of the role, including all relevant regulatory and legislative training
• When dealing with all customers, clients or colleagues ensure that we provide a clear, fair and consistent high quality service that presents a professional and positive image of CMC Markets
• Take all reasonable steps to ensure appropriate confidentiality
• Undertake such other duties, training and/or hours of work as may be reasonably required and which are consistent with the general level of responsibility of this role

KEY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
• 3–7 years’ professional experience in MLOps, ML platform engineering, ML infrastructure, backend engineering, DevOps or SRE.
• Strong production Python skills, including clean APIs, testing, performance awareness and maintainable services.
• Experience deploying, serving and operating machine-learning models in production environments.
• Practical understanding of the ML lifecycle, including training, validation, inference, model release, monitoring and retraining.
• Experience designing CI/CD workflows and release processes for ML or other production software systems.
• Hands-on experience with at least one workflow or orchestration system used for ML training, validation or deployment.
• Comfort working with cloud infrastructure, containers, infrastructure as code and service networking.
• Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, alerting, incident response and common failure modes in ML systems.
• Ability to reason about system design, reliability and operational trade-offs—not just individual tools.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with research, engineering, platform, security and product teams.
Nice to have
• Prior ownership of model monitoring, drift detection or automated retraining.
• Familiarity with model registries, feature stores and offline/online feature-consistency challenges.
• Experience supporting multiple models, services or teams on a shared ML platform.
• Exposure to regulated or high-reliability production environments.
• Experience with PyTorch or similar ML frameworks and model-serving technologies.

Technology environment
Language: Python
ML tooling: PyTorch or similar frameworks, experiment tracking and model registries
Workflow orchestration: ML workflows for training, validation, deployment and retraining
Deployment: Containers, model-serving frameworks and infrastructure as code
Observability: Metrics, logging, tracing, alerting and monitoring across model, service and platform layers
Cloud: Managed compute, storage and networking, with a provider-agnostic mindset
The technology stack will evolve. We value engineers who understand why systems are designed in particular ways and can adapt as requirements and tools change.

Why this role matters
Machine-learning models only create value when they are correct, observable and dependable in production. This role is responsible for making that happen.

You’ll reduce the gap between promising experiments and production systems that can be trusted by downstream products and customers. Your work will improve the reliability, speed and scalability of the ML platform across the organisation.

If you care about operational clarity, robust engineering and building ML systems that do not silently fail, this role gives you direct leverage over the success of our machine-learning capabilities.

Bitget currently leads in the tokenized TradFi market, providing the industry's lowest fees and highest liquidity across 150 regions worldwide.

What you'll do

1. Be responsible for the identification, analysis, design and continuous optimization of risks in the core mechanisms of transactions and financial products, converting market risks, credit risks, liquidity risks and user behavior risks into clear mechanism boundaries, parameter standards and system control requirements.
2. Based on personal expertise, independently be responsible for at least one of the following capability directions:
- UTA, unified margin, account equity, collateral discount, margin calculation, risk limits, liquidation, receivership, insurance pool, ADL and position liquidation losses;
- Index price, mark price, fair price, Funding, price protection, abnormal price source elimination and downgrade mechanism;
- Wealth management, lending, institutional credit, LTV, quota, concentration, redemption liquidity and counterparty risk;
- Core parameter governance, stress testing, sensitivity analysis, risk exposure and tail loss calculation;
- Copy Trading and other special business rules, incentives, order transmission, risk aggregation and abnormal downgrade mechanisms.
3. Conduct pre-risk reviews for new products, new businesses and major mechanism changes, clearly defining risk red lines, entry conditions, parameter boundaries, blocking items, monitoring indicators and launch acceptance standards.
4. Establish a mechanism health monitoring and abnormal warning system, promptly identifying issues such as margin failure, price deviation, clearing anomalies, parameter mismatch,失控 risk exposure and protection mechanism missteps.
5. Take professional responses to major risk events within the responsible capability domain， completing risk judgment， emergency stop-loss suggestions， parameter adjustments， downgrade or rollback plans， as well as event review and rectification acceptance.
6. Collaborate with product， platform risk control， algorithm， data， R&D and SRE teams to convert risk requirements into product solutions， calculation logic， test cases， monitoring alerts， emergency plans and system capabilities.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Reconciliation & Settlement Manager to take ownership of the reconciliation and settlement processes across our payment and financial operations.

The role will be responsible for ensuring that transactions are accurately reconciled, funds are settled correctly and on time, discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly, and financial movements across multiple accounts, currencies, payment channels and partners are properly controlled.

The role will have particular responsibility for supporting cross-border payment flows, including monitoring settlement across different markets, currencies, banking/payment partners and transaction channels.

This is a critical role within the business, sitting at the intersection of Finance, Payments, Operations, Treasury, Risk and Compliance.

Responsibilities

Reconciliation Management

• Own the end-to-end reconciliation process across all relevant transaction and payment channels.
• Perform daily reconciliation of customer transactions against internal ledgers, bank accounts, wallets and payment/settlement partner records.
• Reconcile fiat and digital asset transactions where applicable.
• Ensure all transactions are accurately recorded, accounted for and appropriately classified.
• Identify reconciliation breaks, unmatched transactions, duplicate transactions, missing entries and other discrepancies.
• Investigate and resolve reconciliation exceptions within defined timelines.
• Maintain accurate reconciliation schedules and supporting documentation.
• Ensure outstanding reconciliation items are properly tracked through to resolution.
• Develop and maintain reconciliation controls to minimise financial leakage and operational errors.

Settlement Management

• Own and coordinate settlement processes across banking, payment and liquidity partners.
• Ensure settlements are completed accurately and within agreed timelines.
• Monitor settlement positions across currencies, accounts and payment channels.
• Coordinate settlement instructions and confirmations with relevant internal and external stakeholders.
• Monitor failed, delayed, rejected or incomplete settlements and ensure timely resolution.
• Maintain appropriate settlement records and evidence for audit and reporting purposes.
• Identify settlement risks and escalate material issues appropriately.

Cross-Border Payments

• Manage reconciliation and settlement processes associated with cross-border payment transactions.
• Monitor movement of funds across different currencies, jurisdictions, banking partners and payment channels.
• Reconcile inbound and outbound cross-border transactions across relevant accounts and systems.
• Track transaction status from initiation through processing, settlement and final reconciliation.
• Investigate discrepancies arising from FX conversion, fees, exchange-rate differences, intermediary charges, timing differences and settlement delays.
• Work with banking and payment partners to resolve cross-border settlement issues.
• Monitor foreign exchange and settlement costs and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
• Maintain appropriate records for cross-border transactions and support required operational and regulatory reporting.

Partner & Banking Operations

• Manage operational relationships with banks, payment service providers, liquidity providers and other settlement partners.
• Monitor partner balances, settlement accounts and transaction positions.
• Validate partner statements and settlement reports against internal records.
• Investigate partner discrepancies and coordinate resolution.
• Monitor agreed SLAs and settlement performance.
• Support the onboarding and integration of new payment and settlement partners from a reconciliation and settlement perspective.
• Maintain a clear record of partner-specific settlement processes and requirements.

Exception Management

• Establish and maintain an effective exception management process.
• Monitor unresolved reconciliation and settlement exceptions.
• Categorise exceptions according to value, risk, age and root cause.
• Escalate high-value, unusual or prolonged exceptions.
• Conduct root-cause analysis of recurring reconciliation and settlement issues.
• Work with Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance and external partners to resolve systemic issues.
• Recommend process or system improvements to reduce recurring exceptions.

Treasury & Liquidity Coordination

• Monitor operational balances required to support settlement and payment obligations.
• Identify potential liquidity gaps or excess balances across accounts and currencies.
• Work closely with Treasury/Finance to ensure adequate funding for settlement activities.
• Support liquidity planning for cross-border payment corridors.
• Monitor currency exposures and settlement requirements.
• Provide timely information to Finance and management to support liquidity decisions.

Controls & Risk Management

• Develop and maintain strong reconciliation and settlement controls.
• Ensure appropriate segregation of duties across transaction processing, reconciliation and settlement activities.
• Monitor transactions and settlement processes for operational risks and potential financial losses.
• Work closely with Risk and Compliance on issues relating to transaction integrity, suspicious activity, fraud risks and regulatory requirements.
• Ensure appropriate approval and authorisation controls are followed.
• Support internal and external audits by providing reconciliation and settlement documentation.
• Maintain appropriate records and evidence for all material financial movements.

Requirements

Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
• 6+ years' experience in reconciliation, settlement, payments operations, treasury operations, financial operations or a related field

• Experience managing high-volume financial transactions and reconciliation processes.
• Experience working with banks, payment service providers, fintechs or financial institutions.
• Experience with cross-border payments and multi-currency transactions is strongly preferred.
• Experience managing settlement processes across multiple banking/payment partners.
• Experience leading or supervising a finance operations/reconciliation team.

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of financial reconciliation and settlement processes.
• Strong understanding of payment flows and transaction lifecycles.
• Knowledge of cross-border payment processes and FX settlement.
• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
• Experience working with financial systems, payment platforms, ERPs or reconciliation tools.
• Experience with data analysis and reporting.
• Familiarity with SQL, BI tools or automated reconciliation systems is an advantage.
• Strong understanding of financial controls and operational risk.

Nice to Have

• High attention to detail — zero-error mindset.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple deadlines across jurisdictions.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Integrity, confidentiality, and high professional ethics.

• Hold credible conversations with business users about their workflows, then go implement the fix.

• Instrument and measure adoption closely enough to know what's working, who has dropped off, and why — owning the outcome rather than the ticket.

• Keep pace with developments in full-stack engineering, AI tooling, and automation, and experiment with new LLM and agent capabilities that could improve our products.

• Have at least 3 years of relevant working experience in AI, software engineering, or a related technical field; the role is not intended for fresh graduates or very junior profiles.

• Hands-on experience with AI Agents, AI applications, or LLM-based solutions, ideally in a production environment.

• Proven experience scaling and enhancing AI products or solutions, including taking existing AI applications, code, or technologies and expanding their usage across teams, markets, or the wider organisation.

• Strong technical experience with Python, LLMs, APIs, databases, and AI platforms/tools.

• Able to work with existing code and solutions, identify opportunities for improvement, and help grow and scale existing AI products rather than focusing only on building new solutions from scratch.

• Experience with AI chatbots, voice agents, or similar AI applications would be an advantage.

• Knowledge or experience with RPA/automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Power Automate would be a plus.

• Experience in fintech, financial services, trading, or a similar industry would be an advantage, but is not essential.

• Strong problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with different teams and stakeholders across the organisation.

Axi's bag of delights

• Competitive and attractive compensation.

• Extensive learning opportunities, such as professional training and certifications and soft skills development.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About The Opportunity

The Core Trading Risk Product team builds the core trading infrastructure and platform-level risk capabilities that support OKX’s spot and derivatives businesses across multiple account and margin modes.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the delivery of trading risk workflow automation, agentic parameter governance, agent-driven execution, and foundational price-protection capabilities. Your scope will also include margin-tier rules, collateral haircuts, price limits, index price, and mark price across spot, derivatives, and Perp DEX scenarios.

You will work closely with Risk Management, Quantitative Research, Engineering, Data, Trading Operations, Legal, Compliance, and regional market teams to translate risk-control methodologies into configurable, verifiable, and observable platform capabilities. Success in this role means continuously improving liquidity, users’ capital efficiency, and the trading experience while safeguarding platform resilience and market integrity.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Drive product planning and roadmap execution. Own product discovery and delivery across risk parameter governance, AI-agent workflow automation, controlled execution, and price protection. Translate risk-control needs and operating SOPs into product requirements, priorities, 3-12-month delivery plans, and success metrics; partner with engineering, risk, quant, data, and operations teams to launch, measure adoption, and iterate.

• Research and iterate on risk-control methodologies. Research, formulate, and continuously improve risk-control methodologies, including pricing logic, risk-scoring models, and approaches for handling market volatility.

• Build platform-level risk controls. Build and optimize platform-level risk-control mechanisms to ensure stability under extreme market conditions.

• Drive effective implementation of risk systems. Collaborate with engineers, quants, data analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure risk systems are effectively implemented and continuously monitored.

• Drive continuous improvement. Continuously improve the product through feedback loops and retrospective analysis of past market incidents or system performance.

•

Stay close to markets and users. Maintain regular communication with traders, institutional clients, and market-making teams. Continuously study crypto and traditional financial market structures, competitor mechanisms, and regulatory changes; determine when to lead and when to fast-follow; and adjust product priorities accordingly.

•

Strengthen team methodologies and AI leverage. Codify risk product methodologies, decision records, parameter dictionaries, and incident case libraries, and mentor other product managers. Design automation and AI-native workflows to improve efficiency in analysis, configuration review, monitoring and troubleshooting, documentation, and product operations..

What We Look For In You

• Five or more years of product management experience in trading-related domains. Be familiar with trading system principles, understanding users' trading, and be able to identify risky scenarios.

• An AI-native approach to work, with the ability to design multi-step automation or agentic workflows incorporating tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and human-review checkpoints, together with an understanding of the access-control and audit boundaries required in risk-control contexts.

• Strong systems thinking and technical judgment, with the ability to work closely with engineering and quantitative teams on real-time, highly available, data-intensive systems and the related configuration, monitoring, resilience, and audit requirements.

• Experience in data-driven product decision-making and risk change management, with the ability to define effective metrics and drive continuous improvement through simulation, backtesting, stress testing, production monitoring, and incident reviews.

• Mature cross-functional leadership and project execution capabilities.

• Rigorous logical thinking, clear written and verbal communication, and fluency in both Chinese and English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and cross-functional teams across global and Chinese-language working environments.

• A bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a quantitative or technical field such as Computer Science, Finance, Engineering, or Mathematics.

Nice-To-Haves

•

A deep understanding of the trading and risk mechanisms for spot, margin, perpetuals, expiry futures, or options, with familiarity with core concepts including the order lifecycle, margin, leverage, liquidation, position tiers, index price, mark price, and price limits.

•

Experience working at a digital asset exchange, securities or futures exchange, brokerage, clearing platform, market-making firm, quantitative trading firm, or another high-throughput trading environment.

•

Experience scaling automation, AI agents, or human-in-the-loop workflows in safety-critical environments.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

• Wellness and meal allowances

• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments Team, based in the US. Payments is where OKX meets the real financial world. Our team has built and operates the infrastructure connecting OKX to dozens of payment channels across global markets, giving users deposit and withdrawal options that are fast, convenient, and — most importantly — trustworthy. That platform moves and safeguards user assets at institutional scale, continuously, across time zones and regulatory environments.

This is not a greenfield team looking for its footing. The team is established, the platform is in production at scale, and we are actively expanding — both in scope and in headcount. That combination is rare: you get the leverage of joining a growing team where your work visibly shifts the roadmap, along with the discipline that comes from a system already trusted with real money.

Payments is a domain that's hard to pick up from the outside — every market has its own rails, its own settlement behavior, its own failure modes, its own compliance expectations. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and partner-facing teams, and you'll set the technical bar for the engineers around you — through design docs, code reviews, and the everyday habit of doing things properly when nobody's watching.

If you like the sound of a team where the problems are genuinely hard, the standard is high, and your opinion changes the outcome, we'd like to talk.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Design and build the core. Develop high-scale, 24/7 APIs and distributed payment services across multiple cloud providers, using Java and Spring Boot as the primary stack. Own systems end to end — from design doc through production ownership.

•

Expand our global reach. Help integrate and scale new payment channels and methods across markets, each with its own technical, operational, and reliability characteristics.

•

Protect user assets. Build for correctness first: consistency, idempotency, reconciliation, failure recovery, and the operational tooling that lets us stand behind every transaction.

•

Set the technical bar. Participate actively in design and code reviews, giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback. Help evolve the standards a growing team builds on.

•

Solve the hard problems. Investigate complex distributed-systems challenges and drive them to resolution rather than handing them off.

•

Partner across functions. Work with product, design, and partner teams across regions to turn ambiguous requirements into shipped systems, and to unblock dependencies before they become delays.

•

Grow the team's capability. Mentor engineers and share what you learn. Seniority here is measured in leverage, not just output.

•

Stay curious. Keep pace with a fast-moving industry and bring the good ideas back.

What you'll take away from this role

•

Deep, practical fluency across a wide range of global payment methods and channels — knowledge that is genuinely hard to acquire anywhere else

•

Experience designing and operating systems entrusted with substantial user assets, where correctness and recoverability are non-negotiable

•

A track record of shipping in a regulated, high-stakes domain at real scale

What We Look For In You

• 5+ years of backend software development experience, with a proven track record of building and operating high-availability, large-scale applications.

• Strong engineering fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and software design patterns — and the judgment to know when to reach for which.

• Ownership instinct. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tickets. When something's broken or unclear, you move toward it.

• Ability to drive cross-team collaboration, managing complex dependencies and competing requirements without losing momentum.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, and comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-paced environment.

Head of Litigation & Investigations, Asia Pacific, Middle East & Africa

•

Manage and lead commercial disputes.

Advise business and business Legal teams on dispute resolution clauses.

Arbitration and trial experience.

Experience leading a team.

Sound judgment under ambiguity. Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a growing regulatory landscape.

•

Excellent written and spoken English

•

Willingness to travel across the region.

Experience in crypto, digital assets, fintech, traditional finance, or payments.

Experience or familiarity with Middle East disputes and enforcement.

Mandarin and/or Cantonese at professional working level preferred — a material advantage for law enforcement and regulatory engagement in the region.

Prior in-house experience

About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, commercially aware, and regulatory-savvy compliance professional to join us as Head of Compliance and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).

The role will be instrumental in building the compliance programme from the ground up, and embedding a culture of compliance across the organisation.

Broader team management responsibilities will be added in due course for regulatory strategy, operational execution, and governance.

What You’ll Be Doing

Regulatory Engagement

•

Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant regulatory bodies.

•

Ensure the organisation meets all applicable governance requirements, including fit and proper obligations for Approved and Designated Persons.

•

Monitor and interpret regulatory developments relevant to virtual assets, and advise senior management and the Board accordingly.

Compliance Programme Development & Management

•

Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive compliance framework aligned with local requirements, FATF recommendations, and international best practice for virtual asset service providers (VASPs).

•

Develop, review, and update all internal policies and procedures covering AML/CFT, KYC, customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, data protection, cybersecurity compliance, and safeguarding of client assets.

•

Establish and oversee the compliance monitoring programme, including periodic testing, gap analysis, and reporting to senior management and the Board.

•

Prepare and present regular compliance reports to the Board and relevant committees, including on regulatory changes, compliance breaches, and remediation progress.

•

Ensure compliance considerations are integrated into new product design and operations from the inception phase by driving solutions that balance commercial outcomes and innovation, while maintaining a robust compliance posture using a clear risk-based approach.

•

Review technical documentation, user journeys, and product flows to ensure compliance risks are addressed; provide clear, actionable and solution-focused advice during the product lifecycle.

•

Build and scale compliance policies governing advertising, social media campaigns, influencer partnerships, and product launches.

•

Partner with Legal, Product, and Marketing teams to operationalize a timely review process for client-facing assets and go-to-market materials.

AML/CFT & MLRO Duties

•

Act as the designated MLRO, with full statutory responsibility for overseeing the organisation's AML/CFT framework.

•

Receive, review, and assess all internal Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) from staff, and make informed decisions on whether to file external disclosures with competent local authorities.

•

Oversee and continuously improve the transaction monitoring programme, with support from global compliance and product functions.

•

Ensure robust sanctions screening against all applicable lists, including OFAC, UK OFSI, UN, EU, and applicable local sanctions designations.

•

Oversee customer risk scoring, risk-based KYC/CDD processes, and enhanced due diligence for high-risk customers, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and customers from high-risk jurisdictions.

Governance & Culture

•

Act as a key member of the senior leadership team, providing compliance input on new products, services, partnerships, and business initiatives.

•

Champion a strong compliance culture across the organisation through training, communications, and leadership by example.

•

Design and deliver AML/CFT and compliance training programmes for all staff, ensuring completion records are maintained.

•

Ensure that the organisation's compliance obligations are adequately resourced, and advise the Board on staffing, systems, and budget requirements.

•

Establish and maintain a compliance manual, risk register and oversee the escalation and resolution of compliance incidents and breaches.

Reporting & Recordkeeping

•

Prepare and submit all required regulatory reports and notifications to relevant authorities within stipulated deadlines.

•

Ensure that all compliance records, SAR documentation, KYC files, and transaction monitoring records are maintained in accordance with applicable retention requirements.

•

Support and facilitate any inspections, supervisory visits, or regulatory examinations.

What We Look For In You

•

Qualifications

•

Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification is advantageous.

•

Professional certification in compliance or AML is strongly preferred (e.g. CAMS, ICA Certificate/Diploma in AML or Compliance, CFE, or equivalent).

Experience

•

Minimum of 8 years of experience in compliance, AML, or financial crime prevention, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership compliance role.

•

Demonstrated in-house experience working within virtual asset service providers (VASPs), cryptocurrency exchanges, fintech firms, or regulated financial institutions.

•

Prior experience as an MLRO or Deputy MLRO is highly desirable.

•

Experience engaging directly with financial regulators and the financial intelligence unit

•

Hands-on experience building compliance programmes from the ground up in a start-up or scaling environment is a significant advantage.

•

Familiarity with the regional regulatory framework and requirements is strongly preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

•

Deep understanding of FATF Recommendations and their application to virtual asset service providers, including the Travel Rule (FATF Recommendation 16)

•

Strong knowledge of crypto-specific AML typologies.

•

Proficiency with blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools (e.g. Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, or equivalent).

•

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.

•

Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify and articulate complex risk scenarios clearly.

•

Demonstrated ability to engage constructively with regulators, external auditors, and law enforcement.

•

High degree of personal integrity and sound professional judgment.

Nice to Haves

•

•

Experience in cryptocurrency or blockchain compliance programs.

•

Experience working in a multi-national financial institution setting.

•

Familiarity with compliance technology and analytics tools.

•

Prior exposure to multi-jurisdictional compliance oversight.

•

In-depth knowledge of crypto products, including spot trading, derivatives, staking, lending/borrowing, DeFi, and stablecoins.

Additional Notes

This role will be subject to fit and proper assessment as part of the licensing process. Candidates must be prepared to undergo background checks, provide regulatory questionnaires, CVs, references, and proof of relevant qualifications. Prior enforcement history, regulatory sanctions, or unexplained gaps in professional record may affect eligibility.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company event

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who lives in the top of the funnel. This is a hands-on, sourcing-first role focused on building and owning talent pipelines across the US, LATAM, and APAC — with the heaviest emphasis on APAC, where our fastest hiring growth is happening and where deep market knowledge is hardest to buy.

You will spend the majority of your time proactively identifying, engaging, and converting passive talent — not processing inbound applications. You will map markets, build long-term talent communities, and become the person hiring managers come to when they need to know who’s out there. If you are energized by outreach that actually lands, by knowing a market better than anyone else in the room, and by building pipelines before the req even opens, this role is for you.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Proactive Sourcing (Core Focus): Own top-of-funnel sourcing across US, LATAM, and APAC. Build and execute multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean and X-ray search, GitHub, Behance, Dribbble, Telegram, Discord, WeChat, Maimai, BOSS Zhipin, referrals, alumni networks, and crypto-native communities.

• APAC Pipeline Building: Serve as the sourcing engine for APAC hiring. Develop deep talent maps across key hubs — Singapore, Hong Kong, mainland China, Japan, Malaysia, Australia, and India — and build region-specific outreach strategies that account for local platforms, languages, notice periods, and compensation norms.

• Talent Mapping & Market Intelligence: Produce competitor org maps, talent availability reports, and compensation benchmarks by region. Translate market data into practical guidance that shapes role scoping, level calibration, and hiring plans.

• Candidate Engagement & Conversion: Write and test outreach that gets replies. Own the candidate experience from first touch through handoff, running screens that assess motivation, mobility, and fit while keeping candidates warm through long hiring cycles.

• Pipeline Ownership & Nurture: Build and maintain evergreen pipelines and talent communities for recurring and hard-to-fill roles. Keep silver-medalist and passive-candidate pools active so we are never starting from zero when a req opens.

• Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with recruiters, hiring managers, and regional HR teams across time zones. Run intake and calibration sessions, share pipeline reviews, and set realistic expectations grounded in market reality.

• Sourcing Data & Reporting: Track and report on sourcing funnel metrics — outreach volume, response rate, screen-to-submit, submit-to-onsite, and pipeline health by region. Use the data to redirect effort toward the channels that convert.

• Employer Brand in Market: Represent OKX to passive talent. Support regional recruiting events, meetups, and community engagement, and help position OKX as the destination employer in crypto across every market you cover.

What We Look For In You

• 3+ years of full-lifecycle recruiting or dedicated sourcing experience, with a demonstrable track record of building pipelines from scratch rather than working inbound applicant flow.

• Hands-on APAC sourcing experience strongly preferred — you have hired into at least one major APAC market and understand its platforms, candidate behavior, and hiring norms.

• Experience recruiting across multiple regions and time zones, ideally including US and LATAM alongside APAC.

• Advanced sourcing toolkit: Boolean and X-ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, portfolio platforms, and region-specific channels. Comfortable finding talent where it is not looking for you.

• Strong written outreach skills — you can craft personalized, high-response messaging at volume.

• Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems and sourcing CRMs; disciplined about data hygiene and pipeline tracking.

• Comfortable operating with ambiguity and shifting priorities in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Nice to have: crypto, Web3, or fintech recruiting experience; additional language capability relevant to APAC markets (Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, Bahasa); experience building talent communities or running sourcing jams and hiring events.

OUR MISSION IS TO ENABLE EVERYONE TO BUILD WEALTH

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

That takes high standards, high velocity and engineers who own what they ship.

Today, we serve over 6 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management. At that scale, performance, reliability and data integrity are part of the product.

Our platform is powered by a modern, high-performance engineering stack designed for scale and reliability: Java 21 (Spring), Go, Node.js (TypeScript), PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Redis, Kafka, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Docker, Grafana, AWS, Kubernetes and Kibana.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Senior Backend Engineers work across our backend organisation. Your team match will reflect your strengths, interests and where you can contribute most.

Across every team, the model is the same: small, autonomous groups, short release cycles and ownership from problem definition through production.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own backend solutions end to end: understand the business problem, shape the requirements, design the solution, build it, test it, deploy it and run it in production.

 - Design and evolve services for performance, scale, resilience and data integrity.

 - Make clear technical decisions with a full understanding of the constraints, alternatives and trade-offs.

 - Keep code and systems maintainable as products and requirements evolve.

 - Diagnose difficult production problems, address their underlying causes and prevent recurrence.

 - Work closely with product and engineering colleagues to turn complex requirements into simple, durable solutions.

 - Review work critically, share knowledge and raise the engineering standard across the team.


WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE

 - Solid, hands-on experience delivering backend services in production — you've shipped and operated real systems, ideally within a microservices architecture.

 - Proven backend engineering experience in Java, which is the core language of our platform. Candidates with strong production experience in Go or Node.js are also encouraged to apply.

 - Proven ownership of backend services built and operated within a microservices architecture.

 - Production fluency in at least one modern backend framework (e.g. Spring Boot for Java, or an equivalent in Go or Node.js).

 - A strong grasp of communication protocols such as HTTP, WebSockets and AMQP, including when to apply each.

 - Deep knowledge of relational databases, including indexing, transactions, isolation levels, locking mechanisms and high-performance design.

 - A track record of designing systems for high availability, scalability and resilience.

 - Clear, structured problem-solving and the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs.

 - Strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgement and confidence learning unfamiliar technologies.

Depth in one backend ecosystem and sound tool choice matter more than familiarity with every technology listed.




WHAT TO EXPECT

 - Recruiter conversation

 - Code Review

• User-centered craft with business teeth. You apply UX principles in service of outcomes. You can describe a time you chose the harder UX path because the data (or the user behavior) demanded it - and what the number did.

• Executive presence. You translate creative vision into business language. You have aligned senior stakeholders on a design direction when opinions conflicted, and you can recount the decision and the aftermath.

• Work closely with decision-makers: Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, and senior design leaders to turn user insight into product direction and shipped experiences.

The Problem You'll Solve
 
Something is always happening - a game, a vote, a number moving - and OG is where traders come to discover it and make their call. That’s the reflex we’re building: the surface should feel like it was built for this exact moment - every time someone opens the app, their obvious next step should always be acting on what’s happening right now. 
 
You will lead merchandising for OG’s surface - deciding what’s featured, how it’s packaged, and how it evolves in real time. You bring the instincts of someone deeply in tune with sports, politics, and real-world events, paired with fluency in how a prediction market trades, to make OG’s surface feel current and alive at every moment.
 
You will operate with autonomy - proposing and making the calls on what’s featured, how it’s packaged, and what comes off the board - while working closely with Product and Market Liquidity and Operations to keep the surface moving as fast as the moment does. 


What You'll Actually Do:
•

Own the merchandised surface end-to-end. You lead decisions on homepage / discovery modules and featured market placement across OG web and mobile - what sits in the hero, what rotates, and what earns its place. Every decision is made against one question: does this get tapped, traded, and come back tomorrow. You make decisions that offer the best commercial quality, working closely with Product along the way.

•

Bring proven merchandising craft to prediction markets. You bring instincts for hero carousels, quick-pick modules, thematic tiles, and high-intent packaging, and translate them into prediction-market terms: multi-contract packages, correlated event bundles, and narrative-driven hubs that make trading on a moment feel as easy and exciting as it should.

•

Build packaged, high-intent merchandising. You create and rotate packages tied to real narratives, and you package for liquidity and clarity so every trade is easy to understand and act on. You propose and make the call on what ships to the module, in step with Trading and Market Ops.

•

Run live merchandising. You swap surfaces in real time during major events - games, elections, breaking news, viral moments. You partner with Market Liquidity & Operations when odds or liquidity shift. You stay calm when the calendar is nights, weekends, and holidays. Speed without sloppiness - you’re managing the public face of the product.

•

Connect the calendar to the product. You own the calendar against sports, politics, culture, and market-moving news so launches aren’t a surprise to the homepage. You flag coverage gaps back to Market Ops before the story peaks.

•

Make discovery exciting, not just functional. You treat the surface as the reason someone opens the app at all - fresh, current, a little addictive. You know the difference between a homepage that’s operational and one that makes someone want to check it again in twenty minutes.

Prove it with experiments. You prioritize, QA, and read merchandising A/B tests with Product and Analytics against CTR, conversion, trading volume, and DAU/return-visit lift. You know when a test is invalid. You instrument your own funnel; you don’t wait for someone to hand you the analysis.

Watch the competitive set and respond. You track competitors closely, and you propose responses, work with engineers and ship them.

Live / calendar ops under pressure. You operate comfortably on event time (nights, weekends, holidays), swapping and re-featuring quickly to keep the surface current as moments unfold.

Cross-functional collaborator. You work closely with Product, Market Liquidity & Operations, and Marketing, communicating your decisions clearly, coordinating launches smoothly and adapting when the need arises.

Domain fluency or fast learning speed. You're comfortable in both idioms - odds, parlays, and hold on one side; order books, contract pricing, and liquidity depth on the other - or you learn fast enough to engage power users credibly on both.

Sportsbook / iGaming merchandising. You have experience building and rotating homepage modules, parlay/SGP-style packages, and live in-game surfacing, with a craft for making a screen feel urgent and exciting.

Prediction-market / exchange merchandising. You have merchandised event contracts or order-book products, and you factor liquidity and resolution clarity into how you package and present markets.

SQL / experimentation tooling. You are hands-on with SQL and experimentation platforms, letting you read your own data and move quickly between tests.

Sports, politics, or culture vertical depth. You have a strong instinct for which moments deserve the hero slot.

Regulatory awareness. You have some familiarity with CFTC-regulated exchanges, so you factor compliance into how you design exciting experiences.

Speed. The calendar gives us the foundation to plan ahead, and we move at the pace of the moment on top of it. If the opportunity is real, the homepage changes tonight.

Frontier. You get to bring proven merchandising craft to a regulated, order-book-driven product that's still inventing its own playbook.

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.
 
 
Role Overview
We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own how money and identity get into OG: signup, KYC, fiat funding, payouts, and the funding experience behind all of it. Fans can’t trade until they can fund, so every drop-off in onboarding or funding costs us volume, trust, and share of wallet.
Your job is to make funded accounts fast and trustworthy, with a design bar you won’t lower. You’ll own the path from signup through KYC and funding to a trade-ready account: the funding methods that actually clear, the failure states that quietly kill conversion, and the feedback loops that move the funnel. Trading surfaces like markets, parlays, and live sit with a partner PM. The front door is yours.
The funding product is yours end to end, including funding methods, limits, retries, risk configuration, and partner UX. You won’t be negotiating bank charters. You’ll be deciding what ships, when, and at what balance of friction against compliance. You’ll report to the VP of Product, who sets strategy across Financial Services  while you own the how and the when for OG.com.


What You'll Actually Do:
• Own onboarding and funding end to end. Signup, verify, deposit, time-to-funded. You make the call on where to trade friction for compliance. The job isn’t shipping a KYC screen; it’s getting people from signup to funded to ready for their first trade.

• Own the funding product. You decide funding methods, payouts, limits, retries, and partner UX, spanning ACH, cards, instant funding, and whatever else clears in the U.S. Authorization and flow of funds are product decisions to you, not a ticket you file with a vendor.

• Treat the money-in funnel as a growth surface. You instrument the drop-off, go after the leaks, and sequence your work against conversion. On the handoff from funded to first contract, you partner with the Predictions PM.

• Hold the design bar on trust and money UX. Clarity, hierarchy, and clean error states aren’t negotiable. When someone’s entering a debit card or waiting on an ACH, “good enough” doesn’t cut it, and you’ll say so. Your feedback is specific: interaction cost, copy, recovery paths, not vibes.

• Wireframe and partner on design. You build your own wires and drive the design conversation, catching the clunky funding and KYC moments before users hit them.

• Talk to users like a peer. You run research on how people really sign up, verify, and move money. You ask them to show you how they fund an account instead of asking whether they’d use instant deposit.

• Drive cross-functional execution. You get engineering, design, data, compliance, payments, and ops working toward the same funded-user outcomes. Nothing in onboarding or funding ships without your sign-off on the product and UX bar.

Requirements:
• Consumer money-in funnel ownership. You’ve owned a consumer signup-to-deposit-to-funded flow, and you can walk us through the funnel you ran, the drop-offs you went after, and the number that actually moved. That’s the bar. Merchant acquiring, B2B payouts, and adjacent-team contributions don’t count.

• Hands-on flow-of-funds ownership at the bank-API layer, not just a gateway. You’ve done real work integrating bank or embedded-banking APIs, whether direct bank and partner-bank APIs or a banking-as-a-service or rails provider, and you’ve owned a funding method, rail, or failure mode end to end. You can point to a specific flow of funds or failure state you ran yourself: a settlement failure, an ACH return or NACHA edge case, a retry model, a routing decision, a chargeback or liability flow. You don’t need to have built a bank core from scratch, but consuming a payment gateway and filing tickets against it won’t clear this bar. The judgment we need comes from having worked at the money layer, so you’re making sound calls on day one.

• Design sensibility as a product skill. You can critique money-in and identity UX with specifics like hierarchy, density, recovery, and trust, not just “it looks nicer.” Tell us about a flow you refused to ship until it was clear.

• An instinct for why funding has to feel instant. In a live-event context, a slow or failed deposit is volume lost in real time. You’ve designed under that pressure, or you can show us you get it.

• Data- and user-driven by default. You instrument your own funnel, size the opportunity, and prioritize off the numbers without waiting for someone to hand you the analysis. You also go to the source, running your own research on how people sign up, verify, and fund, and letting what you learn reshape the roadmap. Both the quantitative and the qualitative.

Strong Plus:
• KYC / identity depth. You’ve owned identity verification, step-up, or risk-tiered challenge decisions yourself. (If a peer owned KYC while you owned deposits, that’s fine, but identity fluency helps here.)

• Regulated on/off-ramp or neobank experience. You’ve sat at the intersection of compliance, rails, and consumer conversion.

• Prediction-market, sportsbook, or real-money-gaming background. You know why funding has to feel instant during a live game.

• Deep design-tool / design-system fluency. You move faster treating design as a peer discipline rather than a handoff.

• AI-augmented product work. You use AI tools with human judgment in the loop to move faster on research, specs, and iteration.

We care about what you’ve built and owned, not the MBA, the pedigree, or the years.

Why This Role:
Onboarding and funding are where prediction markets win or lose share of wallet. Regulated U.S. prediction markets still don’t have a default “money-in” experience, and the playbook is yours to write, backed by crypto.com’s compliance and scale. You’ll work directly with product leadership, and your UX and prioritization calls will land where strategy gets set.

【核心职责】
1. 量化交易系统全链路质量控制
引擎与接口测试： 主导撮合引擎（Matching Engine）、行情推送（Market Data Feed）及 API 网关的性能与一致性测试。
确保在百万级 TPS 压力下，订单延迟（Latency）维持在微秒/毫秒级标准，且无丢单、错单现象。
策略回测与仿真验证： 搭建高保真仿真环境（Simulation Environment），验证量化策略从“研究回测”到“实盘部署”的一致性。
重点排查滑点模拟、费率计算、资金费率更新等细节偏差，防止因环境差异导致的策略失效。
数据完整性校验： 建立自动化数据核对机制，确保 Tick 数据、K 线数据、持仓数据与清算数据在分布式架构下的最终一致性。
2. 风控与资金安全专项测试
极端行情压力测试： 设计“黑天鹅”场景（如瞬时暴跌、流动性枯竭），验证强平引擎（Liquidation Engine）、风险准备金及自动减仓机制（ADL）的触发准确性与系统稳定性。
防恶意套利（Anti-Toxic Flow）验证： 配合量化研究员，针对洗售交易（Wash Trading）、自成交、延迟套利等异常行为构建检测用例，确保风控规则能实时拦截恶意流量，保护平台与其他用户利益。
资金结算审计： 自动化验证每日盈亏（P&L）、资金费率结算、手续费返还等财务逻辑的绝对准确，确保与财务账目零误差。
3. 测试基建与效能提升
低延迟测试框架开发： 基于 Rust/Java/Python 开发专用的低延迟测试工具链，支持纳秒级时间戳对齐与高频报文回放。
CI/CD 量化流水线集成： 将量化策略的代码检查、静态分析、单元测试及集成测试嵌入 DevOps 流程，实现策略代码的“分钟级”安全发布。
混沌工程实践： 定期在生产隔离环境中注入网络抖动、节点宕机等故障，验证交易系统的容灾切换能力与数据恢复机制。

计算机科学、数学、金融工程等相关专业本科及以上学历。
5年以上软件测试开发经验，其中至少 2-3年 专注于高频交易、证券交易所、投行核心交易系统或头部 Crypto Exchange 测试开发工作。
2. 技术栈要求
编程语言： 精通 Python（用于测试脚本与数据分析），熟悉 C++ 或 Java（能阅读底层交易引擎代码，定位并发与内存问题）。

Engineer self-healing capabilities: auto-remediation, error-budget-gated rollback, and automated traffic rerouting

Mentor junior SREs and Reliability Champions on reliability patterns and production engineering discipline
